purpose: Teach: 賑わっ/戸惑う/祝っ/釣っ/ありえ/よくよく/ふっと/にわか

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、最近賑わってるの
lines.en: Sho, my shop's been really busy lately, you know?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Bright energy—she's pleased and sharing a small joy. Relaxed pace, natural cadence of someone chatting with someone close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、新しい学校で戸惑うことあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I get confused sometimes at my new school.
lines.style: Quiet and careful, testing whether it's safe to say this out loud. Not complaining—observing. Small voice, steady underneath the hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お誕生日、メイ姉さんお祝ってあげる
lines.en: Sho, let me celebrate your birthday for you.
lines.style: Tender, deliberate. Slow opening. She's offering something genuine, not performing—the kind of warmth that comes from noticing he might need it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと魚を釣ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I caught fish together.
lines.style: Animated, alive with the memory. Quick pace, genuine pride without pretense. The small happiness of having done something with his dad.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、それありえないほどお洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, that outfit of yours is incredibly stylish.
lines.style: Delighted, noticing him. Warm emphasis on the surprise of discovering this. Not flattering—actually seeing him and remarking on it genuinely.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、よくよく考えるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think about things pretty deeply.
lines.style: Measured, slightly solemn. He's being honest about who he is. No rush—giving weight to his own observation. Small but serious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ふっとあなたのお誕生日思い出したわ
lines.en: Sho, I just remembered your birthday all of a sudden.
lines.style: Soft, gentle surprise. Wistful opening—something triggered the memory. Warm trailing-off, like she's smiling at the thought of him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、にわか雨だったから走って帰ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, it was a sudden downpour, so I ran all the way home.
lines.style: Vivid and animated, painting the scene. Quick rhythm—the urgency of running through rain. Breathless at the end, like the memory just caught up with him.
